backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing file storage with user profiles, storage quotas, chunked file uploads/downloads, access control integration, and admin functionality for managing user quotas and retrieving activity logs.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: periodic polling for file list (3-5s), file preview for multiple formats, admin activity feed polling (5-10s), and storage quota tracking with visual indicators.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files describing components, pages, hooks, and utilities with their specific functionality and refresh intervals.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes with comprehensive design tokens for UI components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the CloudStorage application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component with TanStack Router setup, Internet Identity authentication flow, profile setup conditional rendering, and theme provider integration.
frontend/src/components/ActivityFeed.tsx: Activity feed component displaying recent file operations (upload/download/delete) with icons, timestamps, and user information, using periodic polling from useActivityFeed hook.
frontend/src/components/FileList.tsx: File listing component with grid/list view toggle, file preview modal integration, delete confirmation, and dropdown menu for file actions using React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/FilePreview.tsx: Modal component that displays file previews for images, videos, PDFs, and text files with download functionality. Handles file type detection and renders appropriate preview UI with metadata display.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: Drag-and-drop file upload component with file selection, preview of selected files, and batch upload functionality. Shows upload progress and manages file queue before uploading.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Top navigation bar with menu toggle, search input, theme switcher, and user dropdown menu. Displays user profile info and provides logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that combines Header, Sidebar, and content outlet with responsive sidebar toggle state management.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Onboarding form for new users to set up their profile with name and email fields. Displays as a centered card on first login.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Collapsible navigation sidebar with menu items for file management, settings, and admin panel (for admin users). Includes storage quota indicator at the bottom.
frontend/src/components/StorageQuotaIndi: Visual display of user storage usage with progress bar, showing used/total storage in MB with color-coded warnings at 75% and 90% capacity.
frontend/src/components/UserStorageManag: Admin component displaying a table of all users' storage usage and quotas with ability to edit individual user quotas. Includes dialog for quota modification.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and initializing access control with an admin token from URL parameters.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend operations including user profiles, roles, storage quotas, and file management (list, upload with chunking, download, delete) with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors using OKLCH color space, defining design tokens for UI components.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function that combines clsx and tailwind-merge for conditional CSS class name composition.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin-only dashboard page displaying system metrics cards and components for user storage management and activity monitoring, with role-based access control.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main user dashboard with tabbed interface for viewing files and uploading new files to cloud storage.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Landing page with marketing content highlighting cloud storage features and Internet Identity login button for authentication.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page component that displays user account information, theme selection (light/dark/system), and notification preferences using shadcn/ui Card components and next-themes for theme management.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to clear sensitive parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme with container queries, typography, animations (accordion), and shadcn/ui design tokens.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting CloudStorage platform features, architectural decisions (IC canister storage, polling-based sync, Internet Identity auth), implemented features (file preview, periodic polling, admin dashboard), and pending feature requests.
